mapper.select: SELECT i.*, v.voucher_no, v.voucher_date, s.txn_date AS statement_date FROM fin_bank_opening_item i LEFT JOIN fin_voucher_entry e ON e.id = i.entry_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = e.voucher_id LEFT JOIN fin_bank_statement s ON s.id = i.statement_id WHERE i.cash_account_id = #{cashAccountId} ORDER BY i.txn_date, i.id
